release_notes: DubCheck is now free. Checking one file per run against every spec profile, with the full signed PDF report, costs nothing and needs no license key — the app never locks. Your first 7 days also include Batch, which lifts the file limit so you can drop a whole folder and get a summary report across it; when the trial ends you simply drop back to the free single-file version instead of being shut out. Editions are gone: Narrators and Studios were merged, so every install now ships all 20 spec profiles across 11 platforms. Existing license keys keep working. Measurements, dylibs and fonts untouched.
